[[File:AA-1_VerboBrain.jpg|thumb|180px|AA-1 VerboBrain highlighted in a 3PO-series protocol droid]]
'''Verbobrains''', also known as '''verbator brains'''<ref name="GTLAA">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> were sphere-shaped parts of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that functioned as central processors. Versions included the [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrain]],<ref name="Blueprints TUC">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection]]''</ref> the [[AAA-2 VerboBrain]]<ref name="AAA2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> and the [[AA-12X VerboBrain]].<ref name="AA12">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''; ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
